items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And, uh, Johnny Beisdorff's brother, a cousin, I don't know whether his brother is, I think it's his cousin. Leonard Beisdorff.

ctx.x: What if I asked the Monk, well who did he play with?

Well he played with, uh, he played with Rhythm Kings, like I told ya. And they had a band for years. They played at the, at the, the first little club. You see there was two little clubs there. The first one was right on the corner of Dryads and Common. Well they had a band in there with, uh, fiddle, bass, piano, and drums. And, uh, Johnny Beisdorff's brother, a cousin, I don't know whether his brother is, I think it's his cousin. Leonard Beisdorff. He was another black, black key piano player. He played piano.…
